name: DeepSeek tokenizer
usage: DeepSeek token estimation and future offline tokenizer integration
risk: DeepSeek offers an official tokenizer zip for offline token usage calculation. This MVP has not bundled that zip yet, so local counts are estimates.

name: Qwen tokenizer
license: Apache-2.0 for code; model-specific terms for weights/API
usage: Qwen byte-level BPE token estimation and future tokenizer.json/qwen.tiktoken integration
risk: Qwen uses byte-level BPE with model-specific control tokens. Use official Hugging Face/ModelScope tokenizer files for exact counts.

name: Z.AI tokenizer API
usage: GLM token counting through the official /tokenizer API
risk: Exact GLM counting should call the official tokenizer endpoint with a server-side API key.

name: Xiaomi MiMo model/tokenizer resources
license: MIT for listed open MiMo checkpoints; API/token-plan terms for hosted models
usage: MiMo local tokenizer/model resource discovery through Hugging Face and ModelScope
risk: MiMo hosted API uses a credit/token plan; open checkpoints require loading their Hugging Face tokenizer files for exact local counts.

name: Hugging Face Hub / ModelScope Hub
usage: Source tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json, special_tokens_map.json, qwen.tiktoken and model cards
risk: The platform license is not the model license. Always inspect each model card before redistribution or commercial use.

name: Anthropic count_tokens API
usage: Claude text and image token counting through the official API
risk: Requires a server-side ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Counts are estimates per Anthropic API behavior.

name: Google GenAI countTokens API
usage: Gemini text and multimodal token counting through the official API
risk: Requires a server-side GEMINI_API_KEY for official mode; local image estimates are rule-based.

name: Mistral tokenizer
risk: This MVP uses cl100k_base as a local fallback until an official Mistral tokenizer file is wired in.

name: Llama tokenizer files
risk: Check model-specific license before commercial redistribution. This MVP uses a local approximation.
